text:
marta: Drafting a tiny redesign: a horizontal "range strip" above the heatmap that lets you pick and compare two windows quickly (no panel nav). Mock: https://files.redwood/compact-strip-v2.png

sam: Nice. Is the strip persistent across dashboard refreshes?

marta: Per-user persistence only (stored in local profile). Product asked to avoid global sticky changes for now.

jin: UX: how do we display p95 vs throughput on the strip? Two small sparklines? Numbers? Both?

marta: Proposal: tiny p95 spark on the left, throughput spark on the right, and middle shows the pinned ranges as thin bars (base = solid, compare = dashed). Hover shows stats tooltip: p50/p95/throughput.

kaya: For sampling visibility: I'd prefer the badge show `1/10 sampled` text on tooltip, badge itself only `1/10`. Clicking opens sampler popover with toggles: `Enable sampling`, `Rate: 1/10`, `Apply to this dashboard / Apply globally` radio.

lee: Accessibility: ensure high-contrast mode changes just enough. Focusable controls must be reachable with tab order: strip -> pinned-range -> sample-badge -> settings. Also keyboard: `enter` pins, `space` toggles sample badge popover, arrow keys nudge by 5% of current window. Add `aria-live` updates for pinned stats.

sam: For screen readers maybe expose a concise label: `Compare ranges control. 2 ranges pinned.` and add `aria-describedby` pointing to the tooltip text. Avoid `role=slider` because these are ranges, not a single value. `role=group` + `aria-roledescription=\"range compare\"` sounds right.

jin: Edge case: overlapping ranges. UI idea: when overlap > 10% we show combined-line and a tiny 'merge' affordance that computes weighted p95. Tooltip: "Overlap — combined metrics (weighted by request count)".

marta: Good call. Add microcopy under strip: "Overlap uses weighted stats. Double-click to clear a pinned range."

kaya: Copy suggestion: shorten microcopy to: "Weighted metrics for overlaps. Double-click to clear." keeps it scannable.

lee: A11y follow-up: ensure the overlap outline has a non-color visual (pattern or dashed) for color-blind users. Also test with 200% zoom, VoiceOver reading of the tooltip should include sample rate and whether overlap is active.

sam: From an implementation POV: the strip should be light DOM with semantic buttons for ranges. CSS snippet (WIP):
```
.compact-strip { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:8px; background:var(--card-bg); border-radius:6px; }
.range-pill { min-width:64px; padding:4px 8px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
```

jin: Analytics event plan: `ui.range_strip.interact` with properties: `action` (pin/unpin/hover/nudge), `base_range`, `compare_range`, `sample_rate`, `overlap_percent`. Keep identifiers anonymized.

marta: I'll add tracking. Also want to include a tiny help link (`?`) that opens docs on how weighted overlap is calculated.

kaya: Regarding sampling control scope: per-user by default; if a user toggles "Apply globally" show a confirmation modal explaining implications and require an extra click.

lee: Keyboard details to document for devs: Tab to focus strip, left/right arrows to move focus, space to open popover, enter to pin, shift+arrow to nudge by 1%, escape to close popover. Ensure these are in the component README.

sam: CI: branch `feature/compact-range-strip` built, tests failing in `heatmap-sync.test.ts` — looks like the hover sync race. I'll queue a quick fix to debounce hover highlight.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch `feature/compact-range-strip` — CI: 2/4 passed, failing tests: `heatmap-sync.test.ts`, `integration.range-strips.a11y`

marta: Thanks. Action items: sam fix hover debounce + test, jin add analytics event and unit tests for overlap calculation, lee run a11y smoke on the prototype, kaya finalize sampler popover flows & confirmation modal copy, I'll update the mock and upload screenshot for docs PR.

kaya: Can we get a screenshot with keyboard focus visible? Helps copywriters and docs.

marta: Will post screenshot here tomorrow AM. Thanks all :clap:
